description: This file defines functions for converting unknown errors into HttpError objects, with specific handling for Zod validation errors, Prisma errors, Stripe errors, and other error types. It includes error parsing, status code mapping, and error redaction, primarily used in server-side error handling.

classes.name: HttpError
classes.description: Custom error class representing HTTP errors with status codes and messages.

classes.name: TracedError
classes.description: Error class that wraps another error with tracing information.

classes.name: ErrorWithCode
classes.description: Error class that includes an error code for specific error handling.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error object has a 'name' property.

methods.name: isZodError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a ZodError.

methods.name: isPrismaError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a Prisma client known request error.

methods.name: parseZodErrorIssues
methods.description: Parses issues from a ZodError into a string message.

methods.name: getServerErrorFromUnknown
methods.description: Main function converting an unknown error into an HttpError, with specific handling for various error types.

methods.name: getHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Maps an Error or ErrorWithCode to an HTTP status code based on error code.

methods.name: getHttpError
methods.description: Constructs an HttpError with redacted message and optional tracing data.

methods.name: getServerErrorFromPrismaError
methods.description: Converts a Prisma error into an HttpError with appropriate status code.
